scope: One opt-in real structured edit model call, service revision workflow, real CAD worker and independent STEP checks
prompt: Move the existing bore to x=20 mm, y=10 mm, keeping its diameter 6 mm and its through depth. Also add a rectangular through slot, 10 mm along X and 8 mm along Y, with its minimum corner at x=35 mm, y=20 mm, cutting the full plate thickness from z=0 to z=8 mm. Preserve the plate feature, its 80 by 50 by 8 mm dimensions, the existing height constraint, and all other geometry and requirements.
limitations: One fixed edit case, not a general success-rate benchmark; configured provider retries can make multiple attempts.
